title: Coop Coins
description: A light weight coin mod that adds very simple and easy to understand currency
body:
A lightweight and easy to use Economy / Currency mod inspired by a variety of different economy and currency mods i've personally played in the past, and fixes a lot of my issues with afformentioned inspiration mods.

Each coin is initially only available through the /give command and not attainable in the creative inventory. This is to incentivize staff to jumpstart their economy by supplying the initial coin supply and control inflation. And removes the ability for Creative players to potentially pull coins from the menu and cheat.

Command to give yourself coins: /give @p coopcoins:{CoinType}

I hope you enjoy
